notes.title: Change Of Plans Regarding Early Access / Demo Imminent
notes.content:
Hello all,

We've decided to not release the game into Early Access, and will be releasing the full version of the game sometime in 2025.  This means we are no longer planning an episode 2, but instead we'll be launching with an additional mode of play, most likely an infinite / arena mode, for those that are not as interested in the narrative and just want to blast and dodge stuff.

We'll also be releasing the demo in the next few days, ahead of Steam Next Fest.  Looking forward to seeing what everyone thinks!

[i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]

notes.title: - First Gameplay Footage Reveal -
notes.content:
Hello all,

We're excited to reveal the first gameplay peek at Operation Zero, showing the first 2 levels of the 5-level first mission:

[previewyoutube=715B7RlJImA;full][/previewyoutube]

There will be about 8 missions total for the Early Access release of the game, each with 5-8 levels.

It's still a bit rough around the edges, but we're smoothing things out for the upcoming playable demo for Next Fest in a few weeks!

[i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]
